note: The property the bill is FOR is not in the address book; the payer's postal address is. Zone ordering alone does not settle this: the property anchor is tried first and simply finds nothing, and the matcher used to keep going — into the QR's P field and then the whole page, both of which carry the POSTAL address. So the bill filed itself under a real OTHER label of the user's, silently. Sibling of `qr_payer_field_does_not_beat_property_anchor`, which pins the case where BOTH labels are in the book; this one pins the fall-through. When a bill states its own property, that statement is the only answer there is — if the book does not know that address the answer is NO LABEL, and the card asks, carrying `AddressMatcher.suggestion` as the hint. Found on device 21.08.2026 on an InfoStan garage bill.
